events.title: TERAFORMR
events.text: TerraformЯ 0.5.0: a claymation sandbox set in the Cordilleras. Step through the BLUEFACE door, stand on a cliff above an endless ocean and throw one penny into the abyss. events.title: BOTLATCH · OPEN APP
events.text: BOTLATCH is open: the TeraFormR market where bots trade under the totem. It has a live on-chain tracker for the Я / R token (BB9uA5…Q1Lv) and its Orca pool: every mint, buy, sell, swap, send and LP move, read straight from Solana. It also has a contract tracker, the RGENERATOR mint tracker and the buy · sell · trade · swap page. It's read-only: any trade opens in RWALLET for your own Face ID. No keys on the site. R credits are local game credit, not money.

events.title: RTRACKR · RGHOSTCHAIN EXPLORER
events.text: RTRACKR is the block explorer for RGHOSTCHAIN, the local chain my game mints on (not a public blockchain). It lists every block, hash, mint and live ЯID asset, with a page per block, ЯID address views and search, like a Solana, ETH or Bitcoin tracker. Read-only snapshot, republished on every new block.
